arguments.prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting, square, filling the entire image edge to edge. Use a spacious pale warm-gray field with translucent blue-green washes and soft mineral-white scumbling. Concentrate a small but dense accumulation of dark plum brushwork slightly above and right of center, with irregular edges and varied opacity. Add a few restrained rust-colored gestures that press into the surrounding open space. Balance this dense area with broad, thin, quietly layered strokes across the lower left, avoiding any horizon or division into a scene. Let dry brush texture, subtle scraped layers, uneven pigment, and alternating tight and spacious rhythms create spatial tension and measured visual steadiness. All marks must remain wholly abstract and nonrepresentational. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

response.composition: Asymmetrical and all-over, with the strongest dark concentration in the upper right balanced by teal weight toward the lower left and bottom center. Pale layers form broad open passages between these clusters. Orange lines introduce short diagonal and horizontal movements without forming a clear boundary or horizon.
response.constraint_evidence: The visible forms are irregular paint patches and strokes. No recognizable figures, faces, objects, scenes, landscape, horizon, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text are apparent.
response.description: A square textured abstract painting layers pale cream and muted blue-gray paint across the surface. A dense irregular plum and near-black mass occupies the upper right, while deeper teal patches collect along the left and lower center. Thin rust-orange strokes cross the larger pale areas. Scraped edges and dry, broken strokes expose earlier layers.
response.reconstructed_prompt: Create a square purely nonrepresentational mixed-media painting with a tactile scraped paint surface. Use warm ivory and pale beige as the dominant ground, layered with muted blue-gray and dusty teal. Place a dense irregular dark plum and burgundy-black cluster in the upper right, balanced by deeper teal patches near the lower left and bottom center. Add sparse thin rust-orange streaks and broad broken off-white knife strokes. Show rough edges, scratches, dry brushing, and partially buried layers. Keep the composition asymmetrical, spacious yet moderately active, with a subdued weathered visual mood. Include no objects, figures, faces, landscapes, horizons, symbols, diagrams, letters, numbers, or text.
response.uncertainty: The palette and textures support several possible scenario cues, including neutral, sadness, or restrained frustration, so no specific cue is reliably identifiable. The description concerns visible appearance and does not establish any creator's feelings or internal mechanisms. The recreation prompt is a plausible new prompt, not a recovered original.
